name: Home Screen Sections Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs and saves hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home-section drafts using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries. It does not yet render the saved sections.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Sections Manager design and Abyss customization UI for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Adds saved and applied Abyss customization settings, exact Collection Manager-style media/collection/tag/library pickers and previews, complete paged content previews, theme-visible controls, and restorable editing for every saved section definition. Test only; it does not yet render actual home-screen sections.
